title: Selamnew Workspace
description: Led the end-to-end product lifecycle for Selamnew Workspace, delivering a comprehensive digital workforce platform for automated attendance tracking, benefit & compensation administration, workforce planning, and employee performance tracking.

architecture.problem: Manual attendance logging and disconnected benefit, compensation, and appraisal records caused operational bottlenecks, compliance risks, and delayed performance reviews.
architecture.tradeoffs: Architected structured relational schemas and automated policy-driven calculation engines for attendance, compensation, and performance scoring over disjointed legacy spreadsheets.
metricsDetail: Authored comprehensive PRDs, FRDs, and user stories for attendance, benefits, compensation, and performance tracking
Owned and prioritized sprint backlogs, leading sprint planning, grooming, and review ceremonies
Designed system process flows, policy validation rules, and approval workflow swimlanes
Coordinated with engineering and QA squads to oversee regression testing, release notes, and documentation

title: CRM
description: Directed the product lifecycle for the enterprise CRM platform, standardizing lead qualification pipelines, deal stage progressions, and stakeholder communication records into a high-visibility revenue operations platform.

architecture.problem: Unstandardized sales tracking and fragmented customer records caused lost deals and unpredictable revenue forecasting.
architecture.tradeoffs: Designed a stage-gated pipeline state machine with mandatory validation criteria, balancing deep managerial visibility with low-friction rep data entry.
metricsDetail: Engineered standardized stage-gate deal progression criteria and lead qualification metrics
Drafted detailed functional specifications, business rules, and edge-case handling protocols
Designed wireframes and interactive UI prototypes with AI prototyping tailored for high-speed sales workflows
Aligned product scope with business executives, sales leaders, and engineering delivery squads

title: Service Desk (SD)
description: Architected product capabilities for the Service Desk (SD) platform, establishing automated multi-tier ticket routing, SLA threshold timers, priority escalation rules, and end-to-end incident lifecycle visibility.

architecture.problem: Manual ticket dispatch and untracked service level agreements caused high Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and customer dissatisfaction.
architecture.tradeoffs: Engineered automated rule-based ticket routing matrices and event-driven SLA timer hooks to instantly escalate unresolved incidents.
metricsDetail: Architected automated ticket routing matrices, severity scoring models, and escalation paths
Authored extensive PRDs and FRDs specifying edge cases, state transitions, and SLA timers
Designed intuitive triage interfaces and telemetry dashboards with AI prototyping
Facilitated sprint planning, user story acceptance testing, and QA validation cycles

title: Fleet Site Logistic System
description: Architected and coded the end-to-end Logistics Management System for a private client using Next.js, Nest.js, and PostgreSQL—delivering real-time vehicle dispatching, driver scheduling, and relational telemetry schemas.
developmentProcess: Requirements Elicitation & Relational Schema Modeling in PostgreSQL
Backend Architecture & Modular Dispatch Microservices with Nest.js
Reactive Operations & Dispatcher Web Dashboard in Next.js
Production Deployment, System Documentation, and Handover Training

architecture.problem: Manual vehicle allocation and lack of centralized route tracking caused frequent dispatch delays and communication overhead for logistic coordinators.
architecture.tradeoffs: Coded a high-performance web dashboard with Nest.js modular microservices and relational scheduling schemas in PostgreSQL over unindexed spreadsheet logging.
metricsDetail: Coded and delivered the full-stack system end-to-end with Next.js, Nest.js, and PostgreSQL
Engineered optimized PostgreSQL database tables, foreign-key relationships, and indexing
Built modular Nest.js controllers, services, and DTO validation layers for fleet operations
Streamlined dispatch turnaround and order fulfillment workflows into production

title: Medaf Skincare Platform
description: Architected and coded the 3-tier Medaf Skincare ecosystem: an automated Telegram Bot for customer routing, an embedded Telegram Mini App (TMA) for visual catalog browsing & AI skin diagnostics, and a centralized Admin Management Web Console built with Next.js, Nest.js, and PostgreSQL.
developmentProcess: AI Diagnostic Questionnaire & Skin Recommendation Algorithm Design
Conversational Telegram Catalog Bot Webhook Backend with Nest.js
Responsive Storefront, Cart Management & Checkout UI in Next.js
Delivery System with Map Selection, Auto-Cost Calculation & PostgreSQL Architecture
metrics: Coded Full-Stack • AI Diagnostics & Telegram Bot

architecture.problem: Customers experienced high decision friction identifying products tailored to specific skin types, reducing checkout completion rates.
architecture.tradeoffs: Designed an intelligent diagnostic questionnaire coupled with a rule-based AI recommendation pipeline matching dermatological parameters to curated regimens.
metricsDetail: Coded the complete full-stack web application in Next.js, Nest.js, and PostgreSQL
Programmed conversational Telegram Bot webhooks in Nest.js for dynamic catalog browsing
Implemented AI-driven diagnostic engine matching customer skin concerns to curated regimens
Integrated delivery system featuring map location picker, auto delivery cost calculation via external location provider, and PostgreSQL order tracking
